name: weReci
description:
weReci is your own recipe collection — the dishes you've saved, the shelves
an agent curates for you, and the web of connections between ingredients,
techniques, and entries that grows as you cook. This connector lets Claude
read that collection directly, so you can ask about your own recipes the
same way you'd ask a friend who actually knows your kitchen.

Search your saved recipes by ingredient, cuisine, or half-remembered idea.
Browse the curated shelves weReci's grouping agent builds for you — themed
collections like "weeknight pasta" or "what's in season" — and ask Claude to
reshuffle them with a creative direction of your choosing. Explore the
connections graph that links your recipes to ingredients, techniques, and
the other entries in your collection, so you can trace how one dish relates
to another or find the thread between a recipe and the person who gave it to
you. If you share a joint cookbook with someone, Claude sees that shared
collection too, exactly as you do in the app.

weReci also keeps a personal memory layer — durable facts about your
preferences, dietary needs, and patterns, learned from how you actually use
the app. Claude can read that memory to personalize its answers instead of
asking you to repeat context every time.

The connection is read-only by default. The one optional write action —
emailing a recipe — has no recipient field anywhere in the tool: it can only
ever send to the verified email address on your own signed-in weReci
account, so there's no way for a misbehaving or prompt-injected agent to
mail anyone else. A second tool can regenerate your curated shelves on
request, but it only rearranges shelf themes — it never touches, edits, or
deletes a saved recipe.

Sign in with your existing weReci account through standard OAuth. Revoke
access anytime from weReci settings → Connected apps — nothing is readable
after you do.

_published_faq.name: How do I add weReci to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add weReci to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://wereci.xyz/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the weReci MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: weReci provides these MCP tools: find_graph_connection, get_graph_node, get_graph_overview, get_recipe, get_recipe_collection_overview, list_conceits, reshuffle_conceits, search_recipes, send_recipe_email, and traverse_graph.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to weReci?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to weReci in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
weReci requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
weReci is developed by Seth Rivers. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
